name: St. Louis Post-Dispatch editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the St. Louis Post-Dispatch Center (staff review Sept. 2021; low or initial confidence as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: The Kansas City Star editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Kansas City Star Center. McClatchy paper; the board endorsed in the August 2026 Missouri primaries and has editorialized against the mid-decade redistricting of the Kansas City 5th District. No November 2026 endorsement roundup surfaced in search as of Oct. 16.

name: League of Women Voters of Missouri (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter; it offers 'a statewide nonpartisan voting guide' (https://my.lwv.org/missouri/nonpartisan-policy) and never endorses candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Missouri Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its 2026 General Election page lists 'unanimously endorsed' positions on all five measures and its auditor nominee.

name: Missouri Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Released a ballot guide on Oct 8, 2026 with positions on all five measures; backs its nominees, including the incumbent auditor.

name: Missouri Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Missouri Chamber PAC)
lean_basis: Statewide chamber of commerce that works 'to reduce taxes, limit regulation, improve education and foster positive economic development opportunities for Missouri employers' (https://mochamber.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Missouri AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation that calls itself 'A federation of unions in Missouri that are affiliated with the national American Federation of Labor' (https://moaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Missouri Right to Life (and its PAC)
lean_basis: Anti-abortion group whose stated mission is 'to uphold and promote the sanctity of all innocent life from inception to natural death' (https://missourilife.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Abortion Action Missouri (Stop the Ban coalition)
lean_basis: Abortion-rights group that 'envisions a world with stigma-free abortion access and reproductive freedom for all' (https://abortionactionmissouri.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: People Not Politicians Missouri
lean_basis: Single-measure committee (No on Prop A) that says Missourians deserve representation 'not advancing a specific partisan political agenda' (https://peoplenotpoliticiansmo.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Sierra Club Missouri Chapter
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its Missouri chapter.

name: Act for Missouri
lean_basis: Volunteer voter guide that says 'We are unapologetically pro-life' and backs 'the Second Amendment as written' (https://new-site.act4mo.org/about.html). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
